_doc: Phất Y Cốc's Effect engine records (world-depth Stage 6; ADR-0009). Merged into assets/data/combat_effects.json under source world-depth:phat_y. Unpriced.

Serve a Term.rule: Contract Sword Canon (layer 1): each second (pulse) you are Pressing and strike nothing (no damaging art hit landed or evaded since the previous pulse) serves 1 Term (Khoản); each enemy art hit you take strikes 1 Term off.
Serve a Term.approx: Tracks art hits on hit_landed/was_evaded (filter kind: art) rather than basic attacks (matching Return to the Scabbard and The Called Blow); strips 1 Term on enemy art hits (was_hit, filter kind: art, cooldown 3.0 s) so basic attacks do not zero out Terms every second.

Gone Before Thanks.rule: The Grey Sleeve (py-grey-sleeve): when a foe you struck falls Broken (or dies/flees), you vanish for 2 s: you gain 1 decoy and +40 evade for 2 s, and your next Metal strike is a certain critical hit.
Gone Before Thanks.approx: In 1v1 combat, foe death/flight ends the fight, so Gone Before Thanks triggers on Broken (foe falling to 25 % health); 'cannot be targeted' runs as 1 decoy + 40 evade for 2 s.

Paid in Full.rule: Contract Seal of the Valley (py-contract-seal) & Hired Sword's Pair (py-hired-pair, 2 pieces): while protecting a hirer, take 20 % less damage and heal on critical hits (2 % of max health).
Paid in Full.approx: Single-side 1v1 duel adaptation (no allied hirer NPC exists in 1v1 combat; spatial_words_check marked paid-in-full postponed): applies contract-guard protection directly in duels with idempotent limits so wearing both the Seal and the 2-piece set never doubles. On was_hit (cooldown 4 s): +20 dampen_taken for 2 s; on crit (per_pulse 1): heal 2 % max health. Post-fight full heal if hirer survives is unmodelled in 1v1.

The Last Step.rule: Grey Sleeve and Seal (py-grey-seal, 2 pieces): after you vanish or evade an attack, your next sword art within 2 s deals 30 % more damage; if a hit makes the foe Broken, you vanish again. Return to the Scabbard (Quy Sao): after 3 s without firing a damaging art, the foe counts as unstruck again (first sword art cannot be evaded) and that counts as a vanish.
The Last Step.approx: Return to the Scabbard tracks consecutive pulses without a damaging art via scabbard_acted + scabbard_idle (matching thinh_vu). Grants acc: 500 on first sword art_fired after sheathing so it cannot be evaded.
